items.title: Roots
items.line: ABC ran Roots over eight straight nights, 23 to 30 January 1977. The finale drew a 71 share and about 100 million viewers, and the series won nine Emmys.

items.title: Star Wars
items.line: Star Wars opened on 25 May 1977 in a small number of theaters. It cost $11 million, took about $410 million on its first run and won six Oscars.

items.title: Elvis dies
items.line: Elvis Presley died at Graceland in Memphis on 16 August 1977, aged 42.

items.title: Atari VCS
items.line: Atari's Video Computer System reached US shops around September 1977 for about $199, with nine cartridges at launch and Combat in the box. It was renamed the 2600 in 1982 and sold about 30 million.

items.title: The Love Boat
items.line: The Love Boat set sail as a weekly ABC series on 24 September 1977 aboard the real Pacific Princess, with Jack Jones singing the theme. It ran 250 episodes, to May 1986.

items.title: Saturday Night Fever soundtrack
items.line: The soundtrack came out on 15 November 1977, a month before the film. It spent 24 straight weeks at No. 1 and sold over 40 million copies.
